source: review R1 (an external audit of 1 Oct 2026) confirmed against main 8b124b8, and the editor's decisions of 2 Oct 2026 (the gate-evidence criterion; Osprey's 413 usable qubits; PsiQuantum demoted; Sol's builder bar; the Maryland link)

fields.err_2q_median: not published (IBM, Dec 2023: performance "comparable to Osprey", which has no published figure either)

items.note: IBM (4 Dec 2023): 'an innovation milestone, solving scale'; never offered on the IBM Quantum Platform, absent from IBM's current and retired system lists; no gate, coherence or readout figure ever published. Not the largest gate-capable superconducting device: the frontier counts benchmarked devices.

ibm_seattle, cloud May-Sep 2023 as an 'exploratory technical demonstration', 413 of 433 qubits accessible, performance 'consistent with Eagle R1' (IBM); calibration shown on the platform, not archived; retired 7 Sep 2023. The frontier counts its 413 usable qubits (the editor, 2 Oct 2026).

Nature 2024: the real-time decoder's 63 us mean latency 'does not yet include feedback into the logical circuit'; 'feedback (which we have not yet implemented)'. Not a closed loop (review R1, finding 2).

Caune et al. (Riverlane/Rigetti): 'a circuit that conditionally applies a physical gate based on the outcome of decoding', FPGA decoder integrated into the Ankaa-2 control system; a physical conditional gate, demonstration-grade.
Ryan-Anderson et al. 2021: corrections 'physically applied' mid-circuit from a look-up-table decoder; 2022: decoded results 'dictate the control flow and operations executed in the quantum program'.
2024 (H2-1): 'syndromes are processed in real-time using a look-up table decoder. Active error correction is then applied'; 2025-26 (H2-2): real-time Steane QEC gadgets and runtime feedback.

Nature 2025: a belief-propagation decoder's confidence value picks the next measurement basis within the clock cycle (foliated distance-2 repetition code, 'real-time decoding'); error detection on low-quality GKP states, demonstration-grade.

Demoted (the editor, 2 Oct 2026): PsiQuantum's June 2026 release dates only the cryoplant (2H 2027) and names no operating date — the 'slipped system date' trigger of §0 (v), §3 verdict 5 and §5.2 fired; the narrative's next test restated.
The Atlas's 5x bar for Sol's full-width layer kept; the builder's own 2x promise written beside it as the promise's test, not the architecture's (the editor, 2 Oct 2026).

The organisation linker linked the state in 'Microsoft's new Maryland research center' to the University of Maryland; the place name is now a no-link span. The §2.3 'Duke/Maryland' links stand: both affiliations are on O'Reilly et al. 2024 (Duke Quantum Center; JQI, University of Maryland).

Hebrew terminology: annealing = ריפוי (masculine) — the Academy's term (Modern Physics 1993, Chemical Engineering 1989, Technique 1946; simulated annealing = ריפוי מודמה, AI dictionary 1997). The Atlas's earlier חישול is forging; the editor's interim הרפיה of 2 Oct 18:40 (metallurgy) turned out to be the Academy's TEMPERING (Technique 1946) and its relaxation in chemistry, biology and medicine — annealing only in the dental dictionary 1991 — so the editor's second order of the day (every term by the academic standards) settled it on ריפוי; the Hebrew CS habit 'חישול מדומה / קוונטי' is named once as an alias in the glossary entry. T1 relaxation = רלקסציה (Modern Physics 1993: תפוגה / רלקסציה; HUJI; Wikipedia). The editor's decisions of 2 Oct 2026.

Every Hebrew term of the Atlas (607 entries: the binding list data/i18n/he-terms.md, the graph overlay's names, the attribute vocabulary, the briefs' and architectures' names) checked against the Academy of the Hebrew Language's professional dictionaries and Israeli academic usage; 31 terms changed across the Hebrew report (§0–§6, §9), 111 briefs, 17 narratives, graph_he.json, the glossaries and the generator's Hebrew strings (about 1,500 lines): fusion מיזוג (היתוך is melting), imaging דימות (הדמיה is simulation), fluorescence פלואורנות, cavity (resonator) מהוד, donor אטום תורם, silicon צורן, optical tweezers מלקחיים אופטיים, fault tolerance סבילות לתקלות, packaging זיווד, foundry מפעל ייצור (בית יציקה casts metal), preprint קדם-פרסום, prior art ידע קודם, benchmarking מידוד, false positive/negative שגוי, substring תת-מחרוזת, IPO הנפקה ראשונית לציבור, cohort עוקבה, time evolution התפתחות, regulator מאסדר, mitigation אפחות, error rate שיעור שגיאות, demultiplexer מפלג, testbed סביבת ניסוי, latch תפסן, time bin משבצת זמן, graph matching זיווג, neural network רשת עצבית, objective אובייקטיב, coaxial cable כבל קואקסיאלי, annealing ריפוי, relaxation רלקסציה. Kept against a dead Academy coinage: מפענח, צומת, ספין, אפיק, קישור, מסילה, מקרר דילול, ואקום (apparatus), על-דק, תפוקה, הפרעה הדדית, מתזמן, שדה קרוב, גידול, קוודרטורה, crossbar, מאך–צנדר, מידת הביטחון. The terms list records the authority (dictionary, year) of every entry. The editor's order of 2 Oct 2026 (19:14).
